newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABS-CBN sets 500 mln pesos for expansion.
newsitem.headline: ABS-CBN sets 500 mln pesos for expansion.

text.p: Philippine television station ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp said on Tuesday it has earmarked 500 million pesos in 1997 for its nationwide upgrading and expansion.

The company said in a statement it will upgrade equipment in existing stations, produce more local programmes and build broadcast complexes in key provincial cities like Cotabato and Iligan in southern Philippines and Tacloban in central Philippines.
It will inaugurate its Dagupan broadcast complex in northern Philippines next week. The network had invested more than 30 million for this facility, the statement said.
